Two afternoon sessions at [RaukR 2026](https://nbisweden.github.io/raukr-2026/) on writing and
publishing with **Quarto**. You already write R and have used R Markdown or Quarto before. These
sessions show what Quarto is as a *system*, and how to go from a single document to a whole project
you can publish.

## Programme

| Day | Session | Slides | Lab |
|-----|---------|--------|-----|
| **Mon 10 Aug** | Introduction to Quarto — the single document (authoring, layout, and the modern output story, including Typst) | [Slides](slides/quarto/index.qmd) | [Lab](labs/quarto/index.qmd) |
| **Tue 11 Aug** | Quarto projects — beyond one file: websites, config, publishing, tips & tricks | [Slides](slides/quarto-projects/index.qmd) | [Lab](labs/quarto-projects/index.qmd) |

Each session runs as **two parts split by a break**, each part reaching a hands-on payoff.

## Before you arrive

See **[Setup](setup.qmd)** for what to install (R ≥ 4.5, Quarto ≥ 1.9, a handful of packages).
